titre: TOEIC Grammar 11 — La voix passive et les verbes causatifs
description: Passif à tous les temps, get, have, let, make. 10 exercices du livret + 34 questions de cours.

questions.question: A concentrated effort from our shareholders ____ to improve the level of competency as well as operational and technical preparedness.
questions.explication: Voix passive : be + participe passé (un effort est requis).

questions.question: This winter, our restaurant ____ a new look centered around the theme of the rainforest.
questions.explication: C'est le restaurant qui subit le relooking : voix passive.

questions.question: Unexpectedly, the manager ____ the trainee present the project to the whole team.
questions.explication: Verbe causatif let : le directeur a laissé le stagiaire présenter le projet.

questions.question: They found all the bank's safes ____ by one of their former security agents.
questions.explication: Phrase introduite par un prétérit : pluperfect passif.

questions.question: Mr. Stoneseifer ____ to have had lunch with our competitor's CEO in a very trendy eatery.
questions.explication: « On croit que... » se traduit souvent par la voix passive.

questions.question: Before you get comfortable, please ensure your hand baggage ____.
questions.explication: Voix passive : les bagages à main doivent être rangés en toute sécurité.

questions.question: The applicants ____ two hours in the waiting room.
questions.explication: Il est vraisemblable qu'on ait fait attendre des candidats (were made to wait).

questions.question: The new hires ____ some good advice to increase their performance.
questions.explication: Les nouvelles recrues ont reçu des conseils : voix passive.

questions.question: The alarming weather forecasts ____ the authorities take radical decisions to protect the population.
questions.explication: Causatif make : sens d'obligation que had et let n'ont pas.

questions.question: Camping fuel containers for gas ____ carriage by passenger in carry-on or checked-in baggage or on one's person.
questions.explication: Voix passive avec présent simple à valeur de règle générale.

questions.question: Dans la voix passive, le COD de la phrase active devient :
La voix passive se construit avec :
Voix passive, présent simple :
choix: The contract is typed by the secretary
The contract is typing by the secretary
The contract types by the secretary

questions.question: Voix passive, présent continu :
Voix passive, present perfect :
Voix passive, prétérit simple :
Voix passive, prétérit continu :
Voix passive, past perfect :
Voix passive, futur simple :
Voix passive, futur antérieur :
choix: The contract will have been typed

questions.question: Voix passive, conditionnel présent :
choix: The contract would have been typed

questions.question: Voix passive, conditionnel passé :
choix: The contract would have been typed

questions.question: Voix passive avec un modal :
questions.explication: The contract can / may / should / could / might be typed.

questions.question: Voix passive avec modal + have :
questions.explication: The contract might have been typed.

questions.question: Get peut être utilisé pour former un passif :
choix: Oui : He got caught with the documents
questions.explication: They got arrested by the police.

questions.question: En anglais, la voix passive traduit souvent le français :
questions.explication: Birds could be heard from far away.

questions.question: L'agent d'un passif est introduit par :
The window has been forced opened ____ a knife.
questions.explication: With = instrument.

questions.question: The evidence was found ____ a passer-by.
questions.explication: By = agent animé.

questions.question: L'agent est absent quand il est :
Quels sont les verbes causatifs en anglais ?
Get causatif se construit avec :
choix: get + COD + infinitif sans to (faire en sorte que)
questions.explication: They got the marketing director sign the contract.

questions.question: Have causatif se construit avec :
choix: have + COD + participe passé (COD subit) ou + infinitif sans to (COD agit)

questions.question: They had the report ____ in advance. (le rapport subit l'action)
They had the secretary ____ the report quickly. (la secrétaire agit)
Let signifie :
choix: laisser (sens moins fort que get, have, make)

questions.question: The barrister let the witness ____ without interrupting him.
Make causatif signifie :
The silence made them ____ talking.
Après make / let / have / get (causatif + COD agissant), le verbe est :
Après make au passif (« they were made to wait »), le verbe est :
questions.explication: Were made to wait.

questions.question: « Elle a demandé à sa baby-sitter d'appeler le médecin. »
choix: She had her baby-sitter call the physician
She had her baby-sitter called the physician
She had called her baby-sitter the physician
She got her baby-sitter to be calling

questions.question: « Il a fait construire une maison » se dit :
choix: He had built a house himself.
He let a house to be built.
questions.explication: Have + COD + participe passé : le COD subit l'action.

questions.question: Voix passive avec modal + be : quelle forme est correcte ?
questions.explication: Modal + be + participe passé.
